استجهلوا (form X)
# اِسْتَجْهَلُوا (istajhalū) /is.tad͡ʒ.ha.luː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَجْهَلَ (istajhala)
# اُسْتُجْهِلُوا (ustujhilū) /us.tud͡ʒ.hi.luː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَجْهَلَ (istajhala)
# اِسْتَجْهِلُوا (istajhilū) /is.tad͡ʒ.hi.luː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَجْهَلَ (istajhala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
